summary: Blocked the Uber baseline paper-order operation before deterministic dispatch. The running queue row, current allocation plan and intent, ready open signal, ready baseline strategy, accepted relationship, two-share target, fresh UBER mark, and fresh USD/EUR reference all agree. However, scripts/papertrader could not establish its mandatory pre-command repository audit snapshot because the controller-owned encrypted OAuth state path was not readable. No command-audit receipt was created, no paper order was created, and no signal, allocation, accounting, portfolio, execution, cash, fill, or performance state changed. The controller must restore readable audit-snapshot access without exposing credential contents before this operation can be retried.
